question_text: Suppose that the splits at every level of quicksort are in the proportion (1−α) to α where 0 < α ≤ 1/2 is a constant. The minimum depth of a leaf in the recursion tree is approximately given by
explanation: Minimum depth occurs when we take the larger partition (1−α) repeatedly, so depth = log n / log(1/(1−α)) = -log n / log(1−α). But option (a) is lg n / lg(1−α) if base 2 and 1/(1−α) = (1−α)^(-1). Actually the expression is log n / log(1/(1−α)) = log n / ( -log(1−α) ) = -log n / log(1−α). Given the options, (a) matches the magnitude.
